placement.description:
Day 1. Camp under the crown. Sigrid says its cliffs are sheer all round; no rope bites this ice.
Day 3. Caves under the foothills, wet with meltwater. Slimes and nothing worse. Torvald thinks they climb right up inside the mountain.
Day 5. Wolves in the upper halls. Torvald went ahead with the lantern and has not come back.
Day 6. Something walks on the summit at night. It is taller than the tent.
Day 8. Sigrid has gone up after him. I wait one more day. Whoever reads this: the way to the top is through the mountain, not over it. Leave the white beast be.
Sigrid Holm. Climbed the White Peak, and stayed.

The summit split under my feet and I fell into the ice. Broke my leg on the ledge. There is a way out east onto the crown's shelf, but a lip of ice rings it, a full storey high, and nobody climbs that. I left Sigrid's Glacier rune in the chest on the shelf. Set it in a slot and it raises a block of ice to stand on; climb it before it melts. My leg will not take me up. Tell Edvard I found the top.

props.description: The summit split under my feet and I fell into the ice. Broke my leg on the ledge. Below me, at the very bottom of the pit, stands an old temple with no door, and a chest in its heart. Sigrid swore her Glacier rune was laid there: set it in a slot and it raises a block of ice to stand on, the only way up out of that pit, and over the lip of ice a full storey high that rings the crown's shelf. My leg will not take me down to it. Tell Edvard I found the top.
